warning.titlePre: Mercedes Citan 108 CDI Injector & EGR Issues
paragraphs: If your Citan 108 CDI has the K9K diesel engine - that's the W415 generation, produced from 2012 to 2021 - injector failure and EGR clogging are well-documented patterns on this Renault-sourced unit. We replace injectors, EGR components, and timing chain components as standard on every K9K rebuild.
